meaning:
θιγγάνω
[in LXX for נָגַע, Exo.19:12 * ;]
1. to touch, handle: Col.2:21, Heb.12:20" (LXX) .
2. to injure (like Heb. נָגַע, and as in Eur., Iph. Aul., 1351): with genitive, Heb.11:28.†
SYN.: see: ἅπτω (AS)

elsewhere.note: By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
